units.source_text: 信辅在大学毕业的那年秋天，去探望当时正在读法律系的朋友。

en.t: In the autumn of the year he graduated from university, Shinsuke went to visit a friend who was then studying law.

units.source_text: 他们在一个墙壁和纸门都很陈旧的八张榻榻米大的客室聊天。

en.t: They talked in an eight-tatami guest room where both the walls and the paper sliding doors were quite old.

units.source_text: 一个约莫六十岁的老人偶从纸门后方探出一张脸来。

en.t: An old man of about sixty suddenly peered out from behind the paper sliding door.

units.source_text: 信辅在这个老人的脸上看出，那是一个常年酗酒的退休官吏。

en.t: From the old man's face, Shinsuke could tell that he was a retired official who had spent many years drinking heavily.
